page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 1488.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include GPU accelerators, and local storage is specified as None.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, this server is designed to deliver consistent compute performance without resource contention. While benchmark data is currently unavailable for this specific configuration, its high core count and substantial memory capacity position it as a high-density resource pool. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents a significant investment in memory and compute density, suitable for consolidating large-scale enterprise workloads onto a single node rather than distributing them across multiple smaller instances.

The c4n-highmem-192-lssd is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-bound simulation tasks that require massive parallel processing capabilities without the need for hardware GPU acceleration.
